title: The Unmasking Hour
description: Two masked strangers decide what midnight means.

dialogue.speaker: The Host
dialogue.text: The candles are down to their last inch, and the orchestra is playing the song that means midnight is close.

dialogue.speaker: The Host
dialogue.text: At the unmasking hour, every guest must choose. What will you two do?

dialogue.speaker: The Host
dialogue.text: Two masks come away at once, and the room holds its breath.

dialogue.speaker: The Host
dialogue.text: Strangers a moment ago; now the only honest faces at the ball.

dialogue.speaker: The Host
dialogue.text: Two shadows cross the terrace as the clock begins to strike.

dialogue.speaker: The Host
dialogue.text: The ball never learns who they were. Neither do they. Perfect.
